happyPath.summary: Fresh-session replay (dasomel/openforge#54, 2026-10-04) activated the skill from its description, then verified against a live ldapium:e2e container (LDAP_ACCESSLOG_ENABLED=true) that a wrong-password bind (exit 49) is recorded in cn=accesslog as auditBind reqResult=49, read as cn=admin,cn=accesslog. Scratch-only; container removed, no source changed.

edgeCase.summary: Disabled the userPassword denylist entry (entryRedactedAttrs) in ui/backend/internal/ldapclient/tree.go; the repository's own unit tests failed with exit 1 (three TestEntryToDomainEntry_Redacts* tests), then the revert restored exit 0.

unverified: Only the accesslog failed-bind behaviour was exercised against a live container; replication, Go-client LDAP-wire Bind/Ping/Search, backup/restore, upgrade, Keycloak federation and browser/UI E2E workflows were not run.
make check contains no live-LDAP step, so it provides unit/static evidence only; the olcAccessLogSuccess: TRUE mutation was not tried and is covered only by the live security-e2e workflow.
Activation was tested with a single skill in .agents/skills, so selection among competing skills was not exercised.
